genre: 工程深潜 engineering-deep-dive（实践宣言型）
move_sequence: HOOK(极简开场: 空仓库首提交) → ARGUE(规模数据: 100 万行/1500 PR/3.5 PR/人/日) → ARGUE(哲学宣言: no manually-written code) → CONTEXT(角色重定义: engineer 的核心工作是 enable agent) → ARGUE(教训提炼: give Codex a map, not a 1,000-page manual) → COUNTER(失败方案的清单式解剖: one big AGENTS.md 四宗罪) → APPLY(替代方案: TOC 化知识库+机械化执法) → CLOSE

moves.evidence_excerpt: We started with an empty git repository
The primary job of our engineering team became enabling the agents
give Codex a map, not a 1,000-page instruction manual
agents start with a small, stable entry point

argument.evidence_types: 规模统计（PR 数/行数/时长）+ 失败方案解剖 + 机制描述（linters/CI/agent）
argument.qualifiers: on the order of / roughly / almost never / mostly
argument.rebuttals: one big AGENTS.md 的四宗罪清单——每条都是一般化教训（Context is a scarce resource / Too much guidance becomes non-guidance / It rots instantly / It's hard to verify）

style_notes: 宣言型工程文的极端案例：'no manually-written code' 哲学直接统治全文叙事；格言密度全库最高（map not manual / try harder 不是 fix / output for output's sake）；失败清单条目本身被提升为普适原则（四宗罪每条都可独立引用）；副标题结构 We + 过去时动词短语（We made repository knowledge the system of record）
